```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(broom)
source(here("R", "00_figure_setup.R"))
```

# Load and Prep Data
```{r data-prep}
df <- read_csv(here("data", "all-data-combined.csv")) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(ilfm = 1 / lfm)

df_multi_study <- df %>%
  filter(species %in% c("ADEFAS", "HETARB", "QUEAGR", "QUEDOU", "QUEKEL"))
```

# Statistical Testing: Slopes and Intercepts Across Studies
```{r interaction-tests}
interaction_results <- df_multi_study %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- lm(ilfm ~ mwp * sp_site, data = .x)
    anova_res <- anova(model)
    row_idx <- which(rownames(anova_res) == "mwp:sp_site")
    interaction_p <- if(length(row_idx) > 0) anova_res[["Pr(>F)"]][row_idx] else NA
    tibble(interaction_p = interaction_p)
  }) %>%
  mutate(sig_interaction = interaction_p < 0.05)

df_plot <- df_multi_study %>%
  left_join(interaction_results, by = "species")
```

# Extract Statistics for Reporting
```{r study-effects-stats}
stats_summary <- df_multi_study %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- lm(ilfm ~ mwp * sp_site, data = .x)
    anova(model) %>%
      broom::tidy() %>%
      filter(term != "Residuals")
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

print(stats_summary)
write_csv(stats_summary, here("output", "tables", "Table_S05_study_effects.csv"))
```

# Create Annotations for the Figure
```{r annotation-prep}
star_df <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    sig = any(sig_interaction, na.rm = TRUE),
    x_pos = max(mwp, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_pos = max(ilfm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    star = ifelse(sig, "Sig. site effect", "No sig. site effect"),
    x_pos = x_pos - 0.03 * (x_pos - min(df_plot$mwp, na.rm = TRUE)),
    y_pos = y_pos - 0.03 * (y_pos - min(df_plot$ilfm, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
```

# Plot Differences Across Studies
```{r plot-differences, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
figSX_studydiffs <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = mwp, y = ilfm, color = study, group = sp_site)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = star_df,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = star),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
    size = 3.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Minimum Water Potential (MPa)",
    y = "1/LFM",
    color = "Site"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Pepperwood" = "#009E73",
    "StuntRanch" = "#E69F00",
    "SEKI"       = "#56B4E9",
    "Sedgwick"   = "#D55E00"
  )) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.25),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )

figSX_studydiffs
```

# Save Output Figure
```{r save-fig}
ggsave(
  plot = figSX_studydiffs,
  filename = here("output", "figures", "main", "Fig_05_study_differences.jpg"),
  dpi = 600,
  width = 9,
  height = 5
)
```
